content:
Here’s a cool new thing coming son: Cibby, a beautifully designed iOS app for physical video game collectors.

The app is by Michael Flarup, who knows a thing or two about rich software design.

“Cibby is an app built for people who love physical games,” per the teaser website. “Explore and rediscover your collection in stunning interactive 3D.”

Big, modern Delicious Library energy so far.

Here’s a preview of what to expect from Cibby:

You can learn more at cibby.app, including signing up for the waitlist before the release.

Cibby looks like a great place to put GTA 6, even if there’s no physical disc involved.
